author: More Perfect Union
description:
Gen Z uses AI the most yet trusts it the least.

We sat Bernie Sanders down with them for a messy debate that isn’t happening in the public right now.

If we’re going to live with AI and push for a future that benefits working people, we need more conversations like this one.
